# Pitsco Education

> > Pitsco Education provides comprehensive hands-on STEM learning solutions with robotics kits, coding programs, and engineering activities designed to prepare future-ready students across all grade levels.

Pitsco Education is a leading provider of STEM education products and kits for classrooms, homeschools, and after-school programs. The site offers grade-specific collections, subject-focused learning modules, and competition-ready robotics systems featuring popular brands like Arduino, 3Doodler, and TETRIX.

## Key Topics

- STEM Education
- Robotics Kits
- Hands-On Learning
- Coding & Programming
- Engineering Design
- Arduino
- 3Doodler

- TETRIX Robotics
- Classroom Resources

- Competition Robotics
- Early Childhood STEM
- Sustainable Energy
- Activity Bundles

## Grade-Level Collections

- [PreK-2 STEM Learning Products & Educational Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/prek-2): Product collection for Pre-K through 2nd grade STEM learning kits
- [K–2 STEM Learning Kits and Classroom Resources](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/k-2): K-2 grade STEM activities, robotics, and classroom resources
- [Grades 3-5 STEM Kits & Educational Products](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/3-5): Grades 3-5 STEM kits including drones, coding, and engineering products
- [Grades 6-8 STEM Learning Kits & Robotics](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/6-8): Middle school STEM robotics, drones, and engineering projects for grades 6-8
- [Grades 9-12 STEM Kits & Robotics Programs](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/9-12): Advanced high school STEM, robotics, and computer science programs

## STEM Subject Areas

- [STEM Education Kits and Hands-On Learning Resources](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/stem): Comprehensive STEM kits, class packs, and project bundles for all levels
- [Robotics Kits & Educational Robot Systems](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/robotics): Robotics kits including TETRIX systems for classrooms and competitions
- [Coding & Computer Science Learning Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/programming-and-coding): Programming and computer science kits with Python, JavaScript, and block coding
- [Engineering & Structures STEM Learning Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/engineering): Engineering design and structural kits for hands-on building and mechanics
- [Hands-On Science Kits & Lab Equipment](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/science-and-physics): Interactive science kits for physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science
- [Educational Drones & Aerospace STEM Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/aerospace): Educational drone kits and aerospace STEM learning systems
- [Sustainable and Renewable Energy Education Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/sustainable-energy): Renewable energy systems and sustainability STEM kits for classrooms

## Learning Environments

- [Classroom Learning](https://www.pitsco.com/pages/classroom-learning): Classroom STEM solutions with activity bundles and hands-on kits
- [Home STEM Learning Kits and Educational Projects](https://www.pitsco.com/pages/home-school): Homeschool STEM kits with step-by-step guides and at-home activities
- [After-School STEM Activities and Learning Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/pages/out-of-school): After-school and summer camp STEM programs with coding and robotics
- [Early Childhood STEM Learning Kits](https://www.pitsco.com/collections/early-childhood): Age-appropriate STEM kits for early childhood play-based learning
